description: Follow a pending USDC trade (requestId from usdc_buy, usdc_buy_with_native or usdc_sell) to its result, like gdex.pro's live progress note: polls every 3s and returns each step as it happened (bridge legs, gas top-up, approve, swap), the outcome and the tx hash. outcome "needs_retry" means a sell broadcast was dropped and can be retried in place with usdc_retry_sell; "pending" after the timeout means still settling: never resubmit.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

name: usdc_wait_for_trade
